# INKWRIT: the card battler template (NetNet game runtime, board genre)

> A one-against-one card battler. Two scribes duel at a desk: heroes with
> health, ink (mana) that rises each turn, a hand drawn from a shuffled
> deck, inked creatures on the board, spells. A run is a gauntlet of
> duels; after each one, every player drafts one of three cards into
> their deck. Alone, an AI scribe of the gauntlet takes the other seat.
> You change the game by editing src/game.ts only. The template already has
> the duel, turns and the turn timer, the shuffle (on the server), hidden
> hands, guards, rush, the draft, the AI, netcode, rendering, touch,
> earn and the store. Do not write renderers, netcode or AI.

## Files

- src/game.ts: THE GAME. Declarations against @netnetcapital/engine:
  game(), cardTable(), card(), upgrade(), earn.rule(), earn.stake(), store.sku().
- src/names.json: the title and every label players read. Cards go in
  "weapons" ({ name, line }), plus upgrades, earn rules and store items.
- Everything else is template machinery.

## Rules the build enforces

- game({ template: "cards", style, places, players: { prefab, max } }), players.max at most 2.
- Exactly one cardTable(...); 4 to 40 card(...)s. The starter deck (8 to 30
  cards) names declared cards, holds at least one unit and cards costing 2
  or less. ai is 1 to 12 tiers { health, smart }.
- A unit has health 1 or more; a spell has an effect.
- Effects: kind "damage", "heal", "draw" or "buff"; target "enemy" (the
  player picks an enemy unit or the hero), "enemy_hero", "all_enemies",
  "own_hero", "own_unit" (the player picks one of theirs) or "all_own".
- Upgrades read four stats only: maxHealth (hero health), might (+attack on
  the buyer's units), haste (+ink in the first turn), amount (+cards in
  the first hand).
- No weapon(...). Asset ids look like "style.lowpoly.frog"; keep game({ style }).
- 2 playtest players must decide duels and fire an earn rule within 4 minutes.

## Units

Health and attack in points, cost in ink (0 to 10), seconds for timers.
Tick rate 30 Hz.

## The loop

A duel: a coin decides who goes first; the second player draws one extra
card. Each turn: +1 ink (up to manaMax), draw a card (an empty deck hurts
more each time), play cards, attack with ready units (a unit is ready the
turn after it lands, or at once with rush; guard units must be attacked
first), end the turn (or the timer ends it). A hero at 0 loses; turnCap
turns is a draw. After each duel but the last, a draft: one of three.

## Common changes

### A new card
card("mirror_moth", { model: "style.lowpoly.jelly_flyer", kind: "unit", cost: 3, attack: 2, health: 2, effect: { kind: "damage", amount: 1, target: "all_enemies" } });
Add its label to names.json weapons. The draft offers every card unless cardTable pool lists some.

### Tune the table
cardTable({ health: 25, duels: 5, turnSeconds: 40, ... }). Lower health
makes faster duels; more duels make longer runs.

### Harder or easier AI
ai: [{ health: 14, smart: 0.3 }, ...]: duel n against the AI uses tier n;
raise health and smart for a harder gauntlet.

### Earn rules
earn.rule("ink_master", { when: "ai.beaten", n: 3, pay: 15, oncePer: "run" });
Events: duel.won (a duel won against a person; never against the AI, never
a forfeit), ai.beaten (a gauntlet AI scribe beaten; a forfeit pays
nothing), run.won (more duels won than lost in the run). Each rule pays
once per run per player, in coins; the room server is the referee; the AI
scribe never earns.

### The buy-in run (required)
earn.stake({ min: 10, max: 100, multiple: 2 }); one top-level line. "stake" is reserved.

### Coins: earn and the store
store.sku("thick_vellum", { coins: 40 });                            // one level of the upgrade for the run
store.sku("skin_gold_leaf", { coins: 500, grants: { cosmetic: 2 } }); // a finish for your quill, owned for good
store.sku("bound_folio", { coins: 120, grants: { gear: "thick_vellum", loseBelow: 0.25 } }); // losable gear
Keep the SKUs the client is wired to (thick_vellum, sharp_nib, quick_ink,
spare_page, skin_vermilion, skin_gold_leaf, bound_folio) at their prices.

## Hidden information

Decks are shuffled on the room server and their order never leaves it; a
hand and a draft offer are sent only to their owner. Nothing in game.ts
can change that.

## Test

engine.test.run({ ticks: 30 * 240, bots: 2 }) plays duels between two
players (bots: 1 plays one person against the AI) and reports duels won
(kills) and lost (deaths), the duel reached (wave), runs, earned by rule,
softlock, ms per tick and the genre's checks under rules.checks.
